body:
Ok so I have been digging a bit more this issue and yes we are duplicating lodash.

To sump up:

* you are using lodash v4
* we are using lodash v3 (one duplicate)
* [client](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-js) and [helper](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js) are using lodash v3 BUT [asking](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/4357cf95d7efb0c1d017a0c897093289bf31c266/package.json#L48) [for](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-js/blob/151a8ea8d079a5fc404d41dd53ae15d42ff020f4/package.json#L9) lodash-compat for old IES compatibility
* instantsearch.js is not asking for lodash-compat

What we end up with is:

* when you require('algoliasearch') you get lodash-compat v3
* when you require('instantsearch.js') you get lodash v3
* when you require('lodash'), since you are asking for v4, you get v4

This is a subject we will tackle soon.

Since the lodash code is very similar in compat/not-compat I would keep using webpack because when gzipped, your code size should not be that much impacted by v3/v3-compat duplicates.

Then in your own code if you want to avoid duplicates, stick to lodash v3.

Let me know what you think. And yes, this is an issue we need to fix.
